purpose: Append-only permanent browser scenarios. Definitions are not execution evidence. Original AUTO-001 through AUTO-008 remain unchanged.

tests.title: Anonymous browser is redirected from Organisation Home
tests.why: Direct navigation must not bypass sign-in.

tests.title: Anonymous browser is redirected from Facilities Home
tests.why: A pasted Facilities link must not grant access.

tests.title: Anonymous Owner API denied and private
tests.why: Owner information must not escape authentication or private caching.

tests.title: Facilities Administrator can reach Facilities Home
tests.why: Verify a positive route with an authorised isolated session.

tests.title: Facilities Administrator cannot reach Organisation Home
tests.why: Department privileges must not become organisation-wide privileges.

tests.title: Organisation Administrator can reach Organisation Home
tests.why: Verify the approved organisation access boundary.

tests.title: Centre Manager cannot read department-wide Facilities API
tests.why: Venue permissions must not be silently elevated.

tests.title: Facilities Administrator can read permitted Facilities API
tests.why: Check actual server-side API access with a role session.

tests.title: Operational Owner can reach Owner API
tests.why: Owner read access requires an explicitly provisioned and attested Owner session.

tests.title: Facilities Administrator cannot read Owner API
tests.why: Facility administration must not imply Operational Owner privileges.

tests.title: No business-data mutation is attempted
tests.why: Reserved non-executing placeholder documents the write-test authorisation gate.
